scopeOfThisRecord: Step 1 of the gene-expression method only: preserve the public GEO series and verify its stated identities. No differential-expression statistic was computed; steps 2-5 of the method were not executed.

platform.title: NHGRI 12k cDNA Custom Array
platform.pooling: single platform; platforms were not pooled and a second platform matrix was not sought

matrix.dataKind: submitter-processed series matrix (processed matrix only; sample supplementary files are stated as NONE, so no raw data accompanies this capture)

sourceFileHashes.verification: each hash recomputed from the preserved bytes with the standard system sha-256 utility and compared with the value the acquisition tool reported for the same path

captureManifest.name: capture.json
captureManifest.note: the capture's own manifest of the five artifact hashes above

samples.toolDetail: The table header's 181 samples are the series' declared samples.
samples.independentCheck: 181 unique sample accessions in samples.tsv; the series matrix table header carries the same 181 accessions in the same order; the !Series_sample_id field lists the same 181 samples

platform.toolDetail: All samples are on one platform, GPL1977.
platform.independentCheck: all 181 rows of samples.tsv state platform GPL1977; the series matrix states !Series_platform_id GPL1977

platformRecord.toolDetail: 12600 of 12600 matrix probes are in the platform record's table.
platformRecord.independentCheck: probe-annotation.tsv holds 12600 rows with unique probe identifiers, matching the 12600 data rows of the matrix table

organism.toolDetail: The samples' taxon (9606) matches the platform's (9606).
organism.independentCheck: all 181 rows of samples.tsv state organism Homo sapiens and taxId 9606

scale.toolDetail: The values look log-scale; they are used as they are.
scale.independentCheck: the matrix values are continuous with negative and positive values present (a linear intensity scale cannot be negative); no further transformation was applied and no differential statistic was computed from them
scale.transformationApplied: none in this session; the values were not transformed because no computation was requested

genomeBuild.toolDetail: Neither the series matrix nor the platform record states a genome build; none is assumed.
genomeBuild.independentCheck: the genome_build column of probe-annotation.tsv is empty in all 12600 rows; no build string appears in the series matrix header
genomeBuild.action: recorded as unknown; no build was invented, inferred or substituted

geneAnnotationCompleteness.toolDetail: The platform record was usable and carries a Symbol column; no Entrez identifier or gene title column is available.
geneAnnotationCompleteness.independentCheck: 10163 of 12600 annotation rows carry a gene symbol; 8997 distinct symbols; 898 symbols are carried by more than one probe; entrez_id and gene_title are empty in every row
geneAnnotationCompleteness.action: probes without a symbol keep their probe identifier; a multi-probe gene stays as several probe rows and is not collapsed to a gene level

statedProcessing.toolDetail: statedProcessing is an empty list for this capture.
statedProcessing.independentCheck: the series matrix carries no !Series_data_processing or !Sample_data_processing field, and sample supplementary files are stated as NONE
statedProcessing.action: the capture is submitter-processed data of unstated processing; no processing step is attributed to the submitters

groupDeclaration.reason: no group definition was provided or confirmed by the researcher, and the samples carry no characteristics annotations to group on
groupDeclaration.availableCandidateField: sourceName / the sarcoma class named in each sample title (16 classes are stated by the series)
groupDeclaration.note: titles name 16 sarcoma classes across 181 tumors, so any two-group contrast needs an explicit, researcher-confirmed declaration before step 3

differentialStatistics.note: no p-value, fold change, adjusted p-value or effect size appears anywhere in this record

verificationBoundary: This record verifies the bounded acquisition-and-identity method for one public series. It does not verify the Welch per-probe test, the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment, the differential-expression stage, or the full capability.

publication.title: Gene expression profiling of human sarcomas: insights into sarcoma biology.
